status: Prospective protocol, not historical precommitment or independent approval
supersedes: retirement-association-protocol.json association declaration only; retirement declaration unchanged
correction: V1 named a five-year FCFE Gordon basis inconsistent with the application's actual steady-state earnings Gordon comparator. Seven synthetic engineering tests ran under V1; no issuer estimation ran. V1 is retained, not silently rewritten. V2 precedes all V2 estimation.

association.dependent: g = r - positive same-period earnings / market capitalization; annual decimal fraction; fully distributable earnings steady-state comparator, not five-year reverse DCF
association.unit: one accepted exact issuer/security observation per frozen cutoff
association.sample: explicit frozen issuer IDs, category levels and cutoff; unchanged full denominator; no hindsight choice
association.exposure: scope1+scope2 location-based tCO2e / same-period USD million revenue, excluding Scope3
association.estimator: OLS, equal weights, fixed intercept/reference categories; standardized solve transformed to original units
association.uncertainty: HC3 covariance, approximate two-sided Student-t 95% intervals, df=n-p
association.claim: Conditional association only; not climate-attributable growth, causation, identified expectations or efficacy
